title: 2002 SEMCOG annual precipitation change from 2001
html:
2002 Annual precipitation change from 2001

Almost the entire region was drier than 2001. W-35 in southeastern Wayne County was 1.88 inches wetter. Largest decreases reported in the narrative are O-26, 15.80 inches; O-13, 15.53 inches; and L-10, 15.26 inches. Most areas north of a line through central Washtenaw and Wayne Counties were over 6 inches drier. Negative numbers mean less precipitation than 2001.

The map covers Livingston, Oakland, Macomb, Washtenaw and Wayne Counties. Crosses locate rain gauges; asterisks mark roof-exposure gauges. Black contour lines connect equal values.
